description: A false-colour infrared satellite image depicting a dense urban area identified as CORINE Land Cover (CLC) code 1110, "Continuous urban fabric". In this representation, healthy vegetation appears in bright red, while roads, buildings, and other impervious surfaces are displayed in shades of blue and grey. A prominent cyan numerical label "1110" is centrally placed within the image. Black outlines delineate distinct mapping units or administrative boundaries. The image shows a complex network of residential and commercial structures with interspersed vegetation. The surrounding context indicates this image is from Nyköping, Sweden, captured on 2011-06-03 by the Spot 5 satellite at a 2.5 metre resolution, using a 1/2/3 band combination, and is credited to CNES 2011©.
